tickets.title: Compare vested option exercise alternatives
tickets.text: Compare cash exercise, same-day sale, sell-to-cover, and no-exercise alternatives for Lina Copperwisp’s 18,000 vested nonqualified stock options at Cloudberry Kite Robotics. Use the current portal share price of $46.80, the $14.20 exercise price, estimated payroll withholding, and household cash reserve level.
tickets.evidence: Lina asked for a comparison of cash exercise, same-day sale, sell-to-cover, and no-exercise alternatives for the vested nonqualified options using the current portal share price, exercise price, estimated payroll withholding, and household cash reserve level; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-09-06.

tickets.title: Review single-stock concentration
tickets.text: Review the Copperwisp household’s single-stock concentration in Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares. The shares represent about $685,000 of the joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody, roughly 58% of the account and about 34% of listed household investable assets when the taxable account, Lina’s 401(k), and bank balances are included.

tickets.title: Update household planning assumptions

tickets.evidence: planning assumptions need to reflect the higher bonus target, expected equity vesting cadence, and reduced flexibility around sale timing; the agreed update to household planning assumptions is due 2024-09-18.

tickets.text: Obtain the current Cloudberry Kite Robotics insider-trading policy, blackout calendar, and preclearance instructions for Lina Copperwisp. Apricot Compass Advisory has not received these documents.

tickets.text: Follow up on the Velvet Acorn Custody online tax-lot page issue for Lina Copperwisp’s Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares. The page shows one lot twice and omits acquisition details on another lot, preventing identification of the lowest-gain shares for a potential sale.
